title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: flux.cpp:16–50 and :81–87 implement nondimensional perfect-gas primitive/conservative conversion and Euler flux; result accuracy is assessed separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads CGNS zones and tags, resolves interzone interfaces, and constructs face adjacency. No independent exact geometric verification establishes all mesh accuracy.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:451–554 forms face fluxes with viscous contributions and uses MPI reductions; force instabilities and lack of controlled validation limit demonstrated quality.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:115 onward supplies Roe/Harten entropy correction and Rusanov fallback; high-Mach viscous mode forces Rusanov in solver.cpp:649–656.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:372–405 uses freestream inflow and extrapolated outflow, slip reflection and mirrored adiabatic no-slip velocity. This is a simplified farfield treatment.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.hpp defaults secondOrder true; solver.cpp:420–438,486–519 uses Green–Gauss gradients and reconstructed face states. No measured smooth-grid convergence order and historical executable is unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:420–438 computes Barth limiter and :486–519 applies it; reconstructed positivity fallback and update scaling exist. No independent production fallback statistics.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: flux.cpp:216–236 implements Newtonian stress and heat flux, and solver.cpp:1030–1036 estimates tangential wall shear. Selected laminar force histories drift or oscillate and do not establish credible convergence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:576–636 executes a local-time point-implicit diagonal update, not full lower/upper sweeps; report.tex:763 explicitly discloses this. The stated multiple steady sweeps do not occur.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 history and inner loop exist; solver.cpp:743–748 caps inner iterations at 15 and :845–852 counts ratio>=1 misses despite target 0.001. Recovered last ratio 0.928488; actual strict miss total is unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition and neighbor exchange are implemented, but persistent full mesh exists on each rank during iteration; historical np1 result histories are empty/failed, so rank consistency is not established.
